description.value: A large-format Walmart Supercentre (Store 3098) in the Guildford area of Surrey, offering full grocery, electronics, clothing, furniture, toys, and baby departments across a two-storey retail building. The store is a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists covering the Fraser Valley corridor, with a broad range of goods from food staples to general merchandise. Parking is noted as rooftop in OSM.
